hooks.command: $d = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $c = [string]$d.tool_input.command; if ($c -match 'fill_sheets\.py' -and $c -notmatch '--semana') { Write-Output '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"[HOOK BLOQUEADO] fill_sheets.py chamado sem --semana. Periodo correto: --semana DD/MM/AAAA"}' }

$d = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $c = [string]$d.tool_input.command; if ($c -match 'REPORTEI_TOKEN=' -or $c -match 'service_account' -or $c -match 'eyJ[A-Za-z0-9]') { Write-Output '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"[HOOK BLOQUEADO] Credencial detectada em texto claro. Use variaveis de ambiente de settings.local.json."}' }
hooks.statusMessage: H3: verificando credenciais expostas em Bash...

hooks.command: $d = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($d -match 'last_7d') { Write-Output '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"[HOOK BLOQUEADO] Parametro last_7d proibido no Reportei. Use date_from/date_to com segunda a domingo da semana anterior."}' }
